memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house, she called her household servants. 'Look,' she said to them, 'this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed. When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.'" - Gen 39:13-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Rejected and humiliated, Potiphar's wife turns her lust into vengeance. She twists the story completely — casting herself as the innocent victim and Joseph as the attacker. She rallies the household servants to her side, presenting the abandoned cloak as "proof." The very act of Joseph's integrity, fleeing, is turned into evidence of a crime he did not commit.

Notice the poison in her words: "this Hebrew." She stirs up prejudice, painting Joseph as a dangerous foreigner brought in to shame them all. When people cannot get what they want, they sometimes lash out to destroy the very person who did right. Rejected desire can curdle into cruelty.

This is a hard reality that Joseph's story does not hide: doing the right thing sometimes brings not reward but false accusation. Joseph resisted sin and was rewarded with slander and scapegoating. The world does not always applaud integrity; sometimes it punishes it.

If you have ever been falsely accused for doing what was right, you are in good company. Joseph was; and so, supremely, was Jesus, who "committed no sin," yet "when they hurled their insults at him, he did not retaliate... Instead, he entrusted himself to him who judges justly" (1 Pet 2:22-23). When lies are told about you, you do not have to defend yourself frantically. Entrust your name and your cause to the God who sees the truth and judges rightly.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have I ever been falsely accused for doing what was right?
2. Do I entrust my reputation to God when lies are told about me?
3. How does Christ's example steady me under false accusation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when I am falsely accused for doing right, keep me from frantic self-defense and bitter retaliation. Help me to entrust my name and my cause to You, who judge justly. Amen.
